rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for visible glow or emitted light, including light from a hot object; the heat is usually understood from context.

example.english: The firefly gives off a faint glow in the grass.
example.traditional: 隻螢火蟲喺草叢入面發出微弱嘅光。
example.jyutping: zek3 jing4 fo2 cung4 hai2 cou2 cung4 jap6 min6 faat3 ceot1 mei4 joek6 ge3 gwong1

rows.note: Use this instead of 光 when the glow is a healthy reddish flush on someone’s face.

example.english: After the run, her face still had a healthy glow.
example.traditional: 跑完步，佢塊面仲透住健康嘅紅光。
example.jyutping: paau2 jyun4 bou6 keoi5 faai3 min6 zung6 tau3 zyu6 gin6 hong1 ge3 hung4 gwong1

rows.note: Use this for emotional warmth or ardour rather than a visible glow.

example.english: Her warmth gave the whole room a warm glow.
example.traditional: 佢待人嗰份熱情，令成間屋都有種溫暖嘅感覺。
example.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 jan4 go2 fan2 jit6 cing4 ling6 sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 jau5 zung2 wan1 nyun5 ge3 gam2 gok3
